description: This file defines the Time class and TimeAsLocal class within the Thunder::Core namespace, providing functionality for handling date and time operations, conversions, and formatting, with support for different platforms (POSIX and Windows).

classes.name: Time
classes.description: Represents a point in time with methods for parsing, formatting, and conversions between local and UTC times.

classes.name: TimeAsLocal
classes.description: Wraps a Time object to handle local time representation and conversions back to UTC.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string into a Time object, supporting multiple date formats.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the Time object into a string representation.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds milliseconds to the current Time.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts milliseconds from the current Time.
